title: This Ponzi Scheme Might END Suburban Prosperity
summary: Strong Towns explains the Growth Ponzi Scheme, in which post-war suburban growth takes on infrastructure costs that new development must keep funding. It describes why municipal finances become insolvent.
why: Recommended in urban planning threads as a clear account of suburban municipal finance.

quote.text: Everyone that wants to know more about this owes it to themselves to watch this strong towns video
